name: Merced Youth Council
org: City of Merced Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: Speak for Merced's young people to the City Council. You find out what youth need, share ideas with city leaders, plan events and go to monthly public meetings at City Hall.
who_can_apply: City of Merced residents ages 13 to 19. Seats are split by Measure C district: two from each of three districts and one at large.
duration: Two-year term, up to two terms. At least 8 hours a month.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Youth Council Application linked on the city page. Current Youth Council members interview you, then city staff make a recommendation to the City Council. You and a parent sign a Parent/Member Agreement.
notes: Meetings are the second Thursday of each month at 6 p.m. in the City Council Chambers, 678 W. 18th Street. Members may miss only two meetings a year without an excuse. There are required trainings and trips. The council can also add non-voting junior high or high school helpers.
